THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/5/2012/HW/321.
My Ref. No.: DS/MG/LND/02/1/10.
Acquisition of Land for the improvement of Badulla - Karametiya Andaulpotha road (23 km + 460 - 23 km + 480)

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act amended by the Land Acquisition Act (amendment) No. 28 of 1964 the land/servitude described below is required by the government and government intends to acquire the said land for public purpose.

Description of the land/servitude to be acquired : The lots of lands mentioned in the following schedule with the extent of 0.0039 hectare from the land Pihillegedarawatte in the supplementary 12, sheet 12 of F.V.P. 613 dated 29.10.2020 of Surveyor General in the Village of Meegahakiula of No. 22 Meegahakivula Grama Niladhari Division in Meegahakiula Divisional Secretary’s Division of Badulla District in the Province of Uva.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No. : LD/05/2005/H/393.
My Ref. No.: DS/MG/LND/04/12/08.
Acquisition of Land for the Development of Roeberry Rural Hospital

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 the land/servitude described below is required by the government and government intends to acquire the said land for a public purpose.

Description of the land/servitude to be acquired : The land Kotiyagasthenna or Kokatiyagasthenna in P. P. No. B/606 dated 15.09.2008 of Surveyor General of 1.5077 hectares in extent in Roeberry Estate Village coming under Oya Palathakorale, in Meegahakiula Divisional Secretary’s Division of Badulla District in the Province of Uva.

Schedule P.P.B. 606 - Lot Number 1 - Extent 1.4050 Hectare Name of the Land: Kotiyagasthenna or Kokatiyagasthenna; Current land use : Garden, with three Jak trees of 18-30 years old, thirty Turpentine trees of 16-20 years old, one Teak tree of 16 years old, six permanent buildings, five water tanks; Name, address and deed number of the Claimant: State, Other particulars: Acquired to government under the Section 38(a) of the Land Acquisition Act, Original Claimant is Madulsima Plantations Limited Company. Required for the development of Roeberry Rural Hospital. The institution which constructed the buildings and water tanks cannot be found, for completing the acquiring activities.

P.P.B. 606 - Lot Number 2 - Extent 0.0773 Hectare Name of the Land: —; Current land use : Road; Name, address and deed number of the Claimant: State, Other particulars: Acquired to government under the Section 38(a) of the Land Acquisition Act, Original Claimant is Madulsima Plantations Limited Company. Required for the development of Roeberry Rural Hospital, for completing the acquiring activities.

P.P.B. 606 - Lot Number 3 - Extent 0.0254 Hectare Name of the Land: —; Current land use : Road; Name, address and deed number of the Claimant: State, Other particulars: Acquired to government under the Section 38(a) of the Land Acquisition Act, Original Claimant is Madulsima Plantations Limited Company’ Required for the development of Roeberry Rural Hospital, for completing the acquiring activities.

All those who claim ownership, interest and any other connection to foresaid land, should appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Meegahakiula Divisional Secretariat on 08th October, 2025 at 10.30 a.m.

In addition, hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies of the nature of their interests in the lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount before the 01st October, 2025. Further, the relevant deeds and other documents confirming the interests and ownerships should be submitted in the inquiry.
S. M. N. Kumuduni, Divisional Secretary, Meegahakiula. On 28th July, 2025, At Divisional Secretariat, Megahakiula. EOG 08 - 0025

Current land use. Schedule 01. Lot No. 68 Name of the Land: Pitakotuweyaya; Discription : Mix cultivation around 30-35 years old; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Aluthnuwara Saman Devalaya (currently possesses by Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Kanchana Kumari); Extent: 0.0850 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 70 Name of the Land: Pitakotuweyaya; Discription : Mix cultivation around 30-35 years old; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Aluthnuwara Saman Devalaya (currently possesses by Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Kanchana Kumari); Extent: 0.0805 Hectare.

In addition, hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies of the nature of their interests in the lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount before the 17th September, 2025.
